questions: Did your head and eyes turn forcefully to one side before the generalized shaking began?
Did one arm or one side of your body stiffen or jerk before the other side?
Did you remain aware during any part of the event?
Did you experience an unusual warning immediately beforehand, such as a strange smell or taste, rising abdominal sensation, déjà vu, fear, or visual changes?
Did you lose consciousness completely during the event?
Did you bite the side of your tongue?
Were you confused, excessively sleepy, or unable to speak normally for more than a few minutes afterward?
Did the event occur while you were standing, and did you feel light-headed, hot, sweaty, or nauseated immediately beforehand?
Did the event occur during sleep or shortly after awakening?
Have you ever had a similar episode before?
Have you ever had brief episodes of staring, unresponsiveness, sudden jerks, or unexplained lapses in awareness?
Have you recently missed sleep, used alcohol or recreational drugs, or stopped using them suddenly?
Have you recently had a fever, head injury, stroke-like symptoms, severe headache, or an infection involving the brain?
Are you currently taking any medication that lowers the seizure threshold or have you recently stopped an antiseizure medication?
Have you ever had a significant head injury, brain infection, stroke, or brain tumor?
Has anyone in your immediate family had seizures?
Did the seizure last longer than five minutes or occur again before you fully recovered?
